decisions.decision: Police part-time clerk position (19 hours per week, $21,800) to be restored in restoration-level override budget
decisions.quote: the select board unanimously agreed this position should be restored in a restoration-level override budget.

decisions.decision: Director of Communications and IT position to be restored in restoration-level override budget as first identified restoration item
decisions.quote: clerk emkey and vice-chair amanda moore agreed this position should be restored in any restoration-level override budget, representing the first identified restoration item.

decisions.decision: Police SRO restored to two positions and Sergeant-level staffing restored to pre-reduction levels in restoration budget
decisions.quote: the select board agreed the restoration budget should restore the sro to two positions and restore sergeant-level staffing to get the department back to its pre-reduction staffing level.

decisions.decision: Include $430,000 in restoration budget for pavement management, representing $151,000 increase above core override level
decisions.quote: the select board agreed to include $430,000 in the restoration budget for pavement management, representing an increase of approximately $151,000 above the core override level.

decisions.decision: Police station public window coverage (3 PM to 7 PM) to be retained in core override budget
decisions.quote: the select board agreed this service level was not acceptable even in the balanced scenario, and vice-chair moore stated the window coverage should be retained in the core (override) budget.

decisions.decision: No additional restoration items needed for Fire Department beyond what is already in core override budget
decisions.quote: the select board agreed that no additional restoration items were needed for fire beyond what was already included in the unbalanced/core override budget.

decisions.decision: Continue pursuing transition of recycling program to Enterprise Fund
decisions.quote: the select board consensus was to continue pursuing this option, while acknowledging that no change could be implemented by july 1, 2026.

decisions.decision: Town Manager Warren-Dyment to develop Town restoration budget figure and communicate tiered override approach to School Committee
decisions.quote: the select board directed town manager warren-dyment to develop the town restoration budget figure and to communicate to the school committee the select board's expectation that the school committee similarly produce its own core/balanced budget and restoration budget in parallel

decisions.decision: Preferred tiered override structure is A+C scenario: Town restoration paired with School restoration
decisions.quote: the work done at this evening's workshop, however, pointed toward an a+c scenario, town restoration paired with school restoration-as the select board's preferred tiered override structure.
